definition: the furnishings that make a room ready to use
description: Three short shots of people sitting down in different rooms. First a young man perches on a small pale upholstered chair in a bare corner of an empty room. Then an older woman lowers herself onto a large sofa piled with patterned cushions in a bright living room full of plants, a side table and a window seat. Finally an older man sinks back into a big brown leather armchair in a room lined with tall bookcases, stretching his legs out in front of him.

taps.phrase: to sit on a small chair

de.answer: Sie entspannt sich auf einem Sofa.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Se está relajando en un sofá.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle se détend sur un canapé.
